title: TmServiceConfiguration
description: The configuration of a telemetry service shared between user and provider.

gRpcServer.description: Address or DNS name of the gRPC server hosting the CDDS TM Service Provider. The IP address configuration is only needed for the CDDS TM Service User.

TmServiceEndpoint.title: TmServiceEndpoint
TmServiceEndpoint.description: Allows the identification of a service endpoint in terms of the parameters provided below.

endpointName.description: An optional endpoint name to distinguish endpoints; for instance for spacecrafts supporting multiple bands.

serviceVersion.description: The CDDS service version of this service

serviceProvider.description: The name of the service provider organization providing the TM service

terminal.description: The terminal providing the TM service

serviceUser.description: The serviceUser (spacecraft) for which TM shall be delivered

frameQuality.description: The frame quality of the exchanged TM.

gvcIds.description: The GVCIDs of the exchanged TM. Requested GVCIDs shall be checked against provided GVCIDs. If the check is successful, the requested GVCID(s) shall be provided.

not.description: The frame quality and the GVCIDs are mutually exclusive; a service endpoint is requested either by frame quality or by GVCID.
